paite: Suaikaite hiaite ahi uh Nehemiah Tirshatha, Hakaliah tapa leh Zedekiah;
heading: Mipite'n Kithukimna Suai Akai Uh
english: Now those who sealed were: Nehemiah the governor, the son of Hacaliah, and Zedekiah,

paite: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah: hiaite siampute ahi uh.
english: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah; these were the priests.

paite: Levi mite: huaite, Jeshua, Azaniah tapa, Henadad tapa Binnui Kadmiel;
english: The Levites: namely, Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;

paite: A-unaute uh, Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan;
english: and their brothers, Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,

paite: Mite hausate: Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani;
english: The chiefs of the people: Parosh, Pahathmoab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,

paite: Huan mipi lak a adangte, siampute, Levi mite, Kongkhak ngakte, Lasa mite, Nethinim mite leh gamte a mite lak a kipan amau leh amau Pathian dan lam a kituamsehte tengteng, azite uh, atapate uh, atanute uh, michih theihna leh theihtheihna neite.
heading: Kithukimna Thu
english: The rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the porters, the singers, the Nethinim, and all those who had separated themselves from the peoples of the lands to the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, everyone who had knowledge, and understanding—

paite: A-unaute uh, amiliante uh lam ah abelh tinten ua, Mosi Pathian sikha in apiak Pathian Dan a om ding leh TOUPA I TOUPA uh thupiak tengteng zui ding leh hih ding a, avaihawmte leh adan thusehte hih ding in hamsia leh kichiamna abawl uhi.
english: they joined with their brothers, their nobles, and entered into a curse, and into an oath, to walk in God’s law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of Yahweh our Lord, and his ordinances and his statutes;

paite: Huan i tanute gam a mite pe lou ding leh i tapate a dia atanute uh la lou ding in.
english: and that we would not give our daughters to the peoples of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons;

paite: Gam a mite'n Sabbath ni a van hiam an nek hiam zuak ding ahon tawi uleh, Sabbath hiam, ni sianthou ni hiam in huaite i lei kei ding uh; huchi in akum sagihna louhaite lak leh leiba chiteng sik i kidek ding uh.
english: and if the peoples of the land bring wares or any grain on the Sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy of them on the Sabbath, or on a holy day; and that we would forego the seventh year, and the exaction of every debt.

paite: Huai lou leng i Pathian uh inn a nasepna ding a kum teng a shekel seh thumna kibasak ding in, thupiakte i kibawl uhi.
english: Also we made ordinances for ourselves, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God;

paite: Tanghou koihna ding, anpiak thillat gige a ding, halmang thillat gige a ding, Sabbathte, kha thakte, sehsa ankuangte a ding, thil siangthoute a ding, Israel a dia lemna kithoihna bawlna dia khelhna thillatte a ding leh i Pathian inn ua nasepna tengteng a ding in.
english: for the show bread, and for the continual meal offering, and for the continual burnt offering, for the Sabbaths, for the new moons, for the set feasts, and for the holy things, and for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.

paite: Ai i san ua, siampute, Levi mite leh mite, sing thillat a ding in, dan a kigelh bang a, i Pathian uh TOUPA maitam tung a khul ding, kum teng a, hun sehsa, i pipute inkote dungzui a, i Pathian inn ua laklut ding in.
english: We cast lots, the priests, the Levites, and the people, for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God, according to our fathers’ houses, at times appointed, year by year, to burn on the altar of Yahweh our God, as it is written in the law;

paite: TOUPA' inn a, kum teng a, i lei theigah masapente, sing chiteng a gah tengteng a kipan gah masapente, tawi ding in.
english: and to bring the first fruits of our ground, and the first fruits of all fruit of all kinds of trees, year by year, to the house of Yahweh;

paite: Dan a kigelh bang in, i tapate lak a piang masapen leh i gantate lak a leng, i bawnghonte lak leh i belamhonte lak a nou masapente, i Pathian inn ua nasem siampute kiang a i Pathian inn ua tawi ding in.
english: also the firstborn of our sons, and of our livestock, as it is written in the law, and the firstborn of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, to the priests who minister in the house of our God;

paite: I tangbuang mek masakpen uleh, i vei thillatte uleh, sing chiteng gah, uain leh thau, i Pathian uh inn a dantante ah, siampute kiang ah i tawi ding uh; huan i louma a sawm-a-khatte Levi mite kiang ah; amau, Levi mite'n, singtang khopi tengteng uah sawm-a-khat ala uhi.
english: and that we should bring the first fruits of our dough, and our wave offerings, and the fruit of all kinds of trees, the new wine and the oil, to the priests, to the rooms of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground to the Levites; for they, the Levites, take the tithes in all the cities of our tillage.

paite: Aaron tapa siampu, Levi mite'n sawm-a-khat alak chiang un, Levi mite kiang ah a-om ding: huchi in Levi mite'n sawm-a-khatte' sawm-a-khat i Pathian inn uah, dantante ah, sumbawm inn ah atawitou ding uhi.
english: The priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites, when the Levites take tithes: and the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes to the house of our God, to the rooms, into the treasure house.

paite: Israel suante leh Levi tate'n buh-le-bal, uain, thau, thillat mun siang tui-um belsuan nasem siampute, kongkhak ngakte leh lasa mite omna, mun siangthou a atawi ding uh ahi. Huchi in i Pathian inn i nuse kei ding uhi.
english: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the wave offering of the grain, of the new wine, and of the oil, to the rooms, where are the vessels of the sanctuary, and the priests who minister, and the porters, and the singers. We will not forsake the house of our God.
